title: Vec — Dynamic Arrays
tips: Use `.push(item)` to add to the end and `.pop()` to remove from the end
Indexing is zero-based: `vec[0]` is the first element, `vec[vec.len() - 1]` is the last
Use `for item in vec` for clean iteration — no manual index-counters needed
Vectors own their elements — passing a Vec to a function moves ownership (use `&vec` to borrow)
